approval_name: Form BRL Licence — Constructing and Working a Brewery for Manufacture of Beer
why_required: Statutory licence required under Rule 3(2) of the Maharashtra Manufacture of Beer and Wine Rules, 1966 to construct and operate a brewery manufacturing beer.
prerequisites: MPCB Consent to Establish (letter-of-intent stage); MPCB Consent to Operate (licence stage); Fire NOC (stage unspecified)
notes:
Core approval. Checklist page reconciles with an older 2014-reviewed page — see SRC-001 staleness flag.
Applies to any person/entity proposing to construct and work a standalone brewery for manufacture of beer in Maharashtra. Does NOT cover the separate BRL microbrewery (restaurant-based) licence — not modeled in this dataset.

approval_name: MPCB Consent to Establish
why_required: Required under the Water and Air Acts for any industry/operation likely to discharge effluent or emit air pollution, before commencement of establishment works.
parallelizable: N/A — upstream in the chain relative to BRL-001
notes:
Exact MPCB category (and therefore exact fee/validity) not established by this research pass; depends on capital investment and pollution profile.
Applies before actual commencement of works establishing the brewery.

approval_name: MPCB Consent to Operate
why_required: Required before commencement of production, including trial production, once the plant and required pollution-control systems are established.
prerequisites: MPCB Consent to Establish must be obtained first — explicitly evidenced (see dependencies.csv).
renewal: yes — renewal explicitly mentioned by source, exact period not established
notes: Applies once the brewery plant and required pollution-control systems have been established (i.e. after Consent to Establish).

approval_name: Provisional Fire Approval / Provisional No-Objection Certificate
why_required: Required for the proposed industrial building/activity's fire safety clearance prior to construction/operation.
parallelizable: yes — can proceed alongside MPCB/Excise document assembly
inspection_required: unknown — plausible but not explicitly confirmed by retrieved source
notes: Applies where fire approval or provisional NOC is required for the proposed industrial building or activity; competent authority (state directorate vs local fire dept) varies by site jurisdiction.

approval_name: Final Fire No-Objection Certificate
why_required: Required after construction or modification of the industrial building for final fire clearance.
prerequisites: Approved planning-authority drawings; compliance inspection against provisional NOC recommendations (if a provisional NOC was previously issued).
inspection_required: yes — explicit compliance/final inspection document required
notes: Applies after construction or modification of the industrial building where final fire clearance is required.

approval_name: Approval of Factory Plan
why_required: Required under the Factories Act, 1948 and Maharashtra Factories Rules, 1963 for a proposed factory plan.
notes:
High confidence on service existence, low confidence on document checklist.
Applies to a proposed factory plan; detailed document checklist was not retrieved in this research pass — treat the document list as incomplete.

approval_name: Factory Registration and Grant of Factory Licence
why_required: Required where the brewery qualifies as a factory under the Factories Act, 1948 and Maharashtra Factories Rules, 1963.
applicability_conditions: Applies if the brewery is classified as a MAH/hazardous or other factory — classification depends on facts (hazardous substances, quantities, storage) not yet available in the BusinessProfile. Treat as needs_information until those facts are collected.
prerequisites: Factory plan approval (DISH-PLAN-001) is suspected to precede this per standard Factories Act practice, but this sequencing was NOT explicitly confirmed by the retrieved source — see dependencies.csv (marked unknown, not depends_on).
renewal: unknown — factory licences are commonly renewed annually in practice, but this was not confirmed by the retrieved source

approval_name: FSSAI Food Business Licence or Registration
why_required: Beer manufacturing is treated as a food business activity under FSSAI's Food Safety and Standards (Alcoholic Beverages) Regulations, 2018.
applicability_conditions: Applies to any food business operator manufacturing alcoholic beverages including beer. Exact licence level (central/state) and document checklist depend on production capacity/turnover/business structure not yet in the BusinessProfile — treat as needs_information until known.
parallelizable: yes — independent regulatory track from Excise/MPCB/Fire/DISH
renewal: yes — FSSAI licences are renewed periodically per standard practice; exact period not confirmed in this pass
notes: See also SRC-007 for the Alcoholic Beverages Regulations, 2018 reference.

approval_name: Registration as Manufacturer/Packer under Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
why_required: Potentially required where beer is pre-packaged for retail sale and the business is the manufacturer/packer under Rule 27.
applicability_conditions: Applicability depends on whether beer is sold pre-packaged at retail and the specific packaging/distribution channel — bulk/institutional packaging may be treated differently. Treat as needs_information until the packaging model is known.

approval_name: Excise Label / Brand Registration for Beer
why_required: UNRESOLVED — the State Excise SCM portal exposes a label-registration system and a fee schedule for beer/wine brands, but the retrieved material does NOT establish this as a mandatory legal precondition for every Maharashtra brewery.
applicability_conditions: DO NOT mark as a mandatory required approval. Status: unknown/unconfirmed. Requires direct departmental confirmation before inclusion in a live applicant-facing roadmap.
notes: Exclude from the default applicant roadmap until confirmed. If shown at all, surface only as an informational note ('you may also want to check X with the department'), never as a required step.

approval_name: MIDC Industrial Land Allotment & Building Plan Sanction
why_required: Statutory land allotment and building plan sanction required under the MIDC Act, 1961 for setting up clean tech manufacturing units in designated industrial zones.
notes: Foundational land clearance providing industrial address and legal title.

approval_name: MPCB Consent to Establish (Red Category - Clean Tech / Solar PV)
why_required: Mandatory statutory consent under Water Act, 1974 and Air Act, 1981 for Red Category Solar PV Cell/Module manufacturing prior to civil work commencement.
prerequisites: MIDC land allotment must be secured first.
notes: Red category manufacturing due to chemical etching and wafer processing.

approval_name: Maharashtra Fire Services Provisional NOC (High Hazard / Cleanrooms)
why_required: Mandatory fire safety design vetting under Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act, 2006 for industrial buildings exceeding 10,000 sq ft built-up area.
inspection_required: yes — Joint site inspection with local fire officer
notes: Evaluates special cleanroom fire suppression, gas leak sensors, and hydrant coverage.

approval_name: DISH Approval of Factory Plans & Cleanroom Ventilation
why_required: Required under Section 6 of Factories Act, 1948 and Rule 3 of Maharashtra Factories Rules, 1963 for high-tech manufacturing plant layouts and cleanrooms.
prerequisites: Consent to Establish and Provisional Fire NOC precede plant construction.
inspection_required: yes — Occupational safety and hazardous process layout review
notes: Validates chemical exhaust scrubbing and worker safety egress routes.

approval_name: CEIG HT Electrical Substation & Transformer Approval
why_required: Statutory clearance required under Central Electricity Authority (Safety & Electric Supply) Regulations, 2010 for electrical installations and substations.
inspection_required: yes — Electrical safety testing and transformer insulation check
notes: Mandatory for high-tension manufacturing plants and utility grid step-up yards.

approval_name: MEDA Clean Energy Registration & Grid Evacuation Feasibility
why_required: State nodal agency registration for clean tech power synchronization and grid evacuation approval under Maharashtra RE Policy.
notes: Facilitates state policy incentives and grid synchronization permissions.

approval_name: CGWA Ground Water Extraction Clearance & NOC
why_required: Mandatory statutory NOC under Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 for industrial groundwater extraction in notified semi-critical or critical industrial clusters.
inspection_required: yes — Piezometer and digital flow meter verification
notes: Applies specifically to units relying on borewell/groundwater in industrial talukas.

approval_name: Directorate of Steam Boilers Registration & Inspection
why_required: Statutory registration and steam test certificate required under the Boilers Act, 1923 for industrial steam generation and pressure vessels.
inspection_required: yes — Hydraulic pressure test & boiler mounting inspection
notes: Applies for process heating, cleaning autoclaves, and de-ionized water steam generators.

approval_name: MPCB Consent to Operate (Red Category - Solar PV/Clean Tech)
why_required: Statutory consent to operate required before commercial manufacturing and trial production under Water and Air Acts.
prerequisites: MPCB Consent to Establish and Fire Final NOC must be obtained first.
inspection_required: yes — Full effluent treatment plant and air scrubber compliance inspection
notes: Final operating license ensuring Zero Liquid Discharge and hazardous waste compliance.

approval_name: Package Scheme of Incentives — 2019
why_required: Financial incentives including industrial promotion subsidy, electricity duty exemption, and interest subsidy under the Maharashtra Industrial Policy 2019.
notes: Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI-2019) eligibility evaluation for Maharashtra industrial units.
exclusion_reason: Beer and liquor manufacturing are explicitly listed in Annexure II (Negative List of Industries) of the Package Scheme of Incentives (PSI-2019) guidelines, disqualifying the unit from state fiscal incentives.

approval_name: Maharashtra Clean Energy & Solar Manufacturing Incentive Scheme
why_required: Capital subsidy up to 25% on eligible plant and machinery and 100% stamp duty exemption for solar cell/module manufacturing units.
notes: State incentive scheme supporting solar equipment and module manufacturing units in Maharashtra.

approval_name: Startup India DPIIT Recognition & Seed Fund Scheme (SISFS)
department: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade
why_required: Provides official DPIIT recognition, access to Startup India Seed Fund (up to Rs 50 Lakhs), 80% rebate on patent filings, self-certification under 9 environmental & labor laws, and relaxation in public procurement.
notes: National startup recognition and funding assistance scheme for innovative entities incorporated within 10 years.

approval_name: Section 80-IAC 3-Year 100% Tax Holiday for Startups
why_required: 100% corporate tax exemption on profits for 3 consecutive assessment years out of a block of 10 years for innovative DPIIT-recognized private limited companies and LLPs.
notes: Tax holiday under Section 80-IAC of the Income Tax Act for eligible startups.

approval_name: MSME Udyam Registration & Priority Lending Concessions
department: Ministry of Micro Small and Medium Enterprises
why_required: Confers statutory MSME status, 1% interest rate discount on bank loans, 50% discount on trademark/patent fees, 45-day payment protection under Section 15 of MSMED Act, and tender fee waivers.
notes: Statutory registration providing broad enterprise protections, concessional loans, and tariff waivers.

approval_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
why_required: Provides up to Rs 5 Crore in collateral-free bank credit facilities (term loans & working capital) with 75% to 85% credit guarantee cover by SIDBI/MoMSME without requiring third-party collateral or mortgage.
notes: Collateral-free credit guarantee scheme enabling bank financing for micro and small enterprises.

approval_name: MSME Sustainable (ZED) Certification Subsidy Scheme
department: Ministry of Micro Small and Medium Enterprises
why_required: Provides 80% (Micro), 60% (Small), and 50% (Medium) financial subsidy on Zero Defect Zero Effect (ZED) certification cost + up to Rs 5 Lakhs testing assistance for clean and energy-efficient manufacturing.
notes: Clean technology and zero-defect sustainability certification subsidy scheme for manufacturing units.

approval_name: Export Promotion Capital Goods (EPCG) Zero-Duty Machinery Import Scheme
why_required: Allows import of modern capital machinery and quality testing equipment at 0% basic customs duty, saving 25-30% capital expenditure, subject to fulfilling 6x export obligation over 6 years.
notes: Zero-duty capital goods import scheme for industrial manufacturing and export enhancement.

approval_name: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) Scheme
why_required: Provides 35% credit-linked capital subsidy up to Rs 10 Lakhs per unit for food and beverage processing units upgrading machinery, hygiene labs, and automated bottling lines.
notes: Centrally sponsored micro food and beverage enterprise formalisation and modernisation capital subsidy scheme.
